Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring businesses to issue rain checks for out of stock advertised items.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring businesses to offer rain checks forout of stock advertised merchandise; and adding a new section tochapter 19.86 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.86 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) No person may sell, offer for sale, or advertise items ofmerchandise for sale at a discount from the normal retail price withoutoffering a rain check for sale items that become out of stock during anadvertised sale period unless: (a) All advertisements for sale clearlyindicate the quantity of items available at the sale price and clearlystate that no rain checks are offered; or (b) a customer accepts acomparable discount on a comparable item. (2) No person may offer a retail promotional giveaway of items ofmerchandise without offering a rain check for promotional items thatbecome out of stock during an advertised sale period unless: (a) Alladvertisements for the promotional giveaway clearly indicate thequantity of items available and clearly state that no rain checks areoffered; or (b) a customer accepts a comparable item. p. 1 SB 6203 (3) A rain check must be redeemable by the retailer for a period ofthirty days from the date of issue.
